title: Slushie Bar Xtra Sweet Melon Sugar 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Sweet Melon Sugar delivers the juicy, refreshing taste of perfectly ripe Melon with a deep, smooth, sweetness. This flavour brings out the natural delicate sweetness of Melon, balanced with a light touch of sugar for an indulgent vape that’s immensely refreshing. Ideal for vapers who enjoy sweet, fruity blends with a clean and smooth finish, Sweet Melon Sugar provides a smooth and satisfying vape that’s perfect for all-day use. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
